PLUMBER – SERVICE & REPAIR (JOURNEYMAN)
Reyes & Sons Plumbing — Phoenix, AZ — $32–$42/hr DOE + on-call pay

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Residential service calls: water heaters, leak detection, drain cleaning, repiping, fixture installs. Average 4–6 calls per day out of a stocked company van.

WHAT YOU NEED
• Valid Arizona journeyman plumber license (ROC) or equivalent
• 3+ years of residential service experience
• Valid driver's license and clean driving record (MVR checked)
• Must pass a background check and drug screen
• Able to lift 75 lbs and work in attics and crawl spaces
• Own basic hand tools

NICE TO HAVE
• Tankless water heater experience (Navien, Rinnai)
• Backflow prevention certification
• Bilingual English/Spanish

WHAT YOU GET
Take-home truck, paid weekly, health insurance, paid holidays, tool allowance. No commission pressure — we pay hourly.

Reyes & Sons is a drug-free workplace and an equal opportunity employer.
